name: The Church
overview: Scripture reveals the church as the divinely established body of Christ, with Jesus as its sovereign Head, who will build it upon a firm foundation that no evil can overcome (Matthew 16:18; Ephesians 1:22; Colossians 1:18). The church is composed of many members, each with distinct roles contributing to the unity and function of the whole (Romans 12:4). Believers are called to steadfastly uphold apostolic teaching, fellowship, and prayer, while guarding against divisions and false doctrines that threaten its purity and mission (Acts 2:42; Romans 16:17). Together, these truths affirm the church as God's chosen community, called out for worship, edification, and witness in the world.
